ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, $OC \perp AB$ at point O, $OD$ bisects $\angle BOC$, $OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$. Find the degree measure of $\angle BOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $OC\perp AB$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOC=\angle AOC=90^\circ$,\\
Since $OD$ bisects $\angle BOC$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOD=\angle COD=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOC=45^\circ$,\\
Therefore, the measure of $\angle BOD$ is $\boxed{45^\circ}$.
